_comment: Stage 1: red-MOT compression + single-frequency hold + red MOT beam power. Biggest lever on final T and lattice loading. Bounds below are FILLERS bracketing the current GUI defaults — tighten to SAFE hardware ranges before running. Order of param_names MUST match min/max/first arrays.
_units: freq_* in Hz, atten_ramp_f in DAC volts (0-9.99), rmot_sf_current in A (<7), durations in seconds, atten_3D_red in dB (1-30)
_note: freq_low_f (sweep endpoint, the compressed 'bottom') is capped at freq_high (180.5e6, fixed in this stage) — going above inverts the compression sweep. If you tune freq_high in another stage, keep freq_low_f <= freq_high.
